*Food*

- *Street Food*: Khau Galli is known for its street food, with vendors selling everything from vada pav to bhel puri.
- *Chinese Dishes*: Some locations have Chinese restaurants, offering dishes like noodles and Manchow soup.

*Ambiance*

The ambiance is casual and lively, typical of street food joints. Khau Galli is a bustling street with multiple food stalls and restaurants.

*Key Features*

- *Variety of Options*: Khau Galli offers a range of food options, including Indian and Chinese cuisine.
- *Affordable Prices*: The prices are generally medium, making it an affordable dining option.
- *Home Delivery*: Some locations offer home delivery, making it convenient for customers.

featured_reviews.name: Saroj Jaiswar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Box Street, Vasai is a wonderful place for families and friends to spend quality time together.
The lively and cheerful atmosphere makes it perfect for an evening outing.

You can stroll around, enjoy the surroundings, and explore a variety of food and drink options that are prepared with proper hygiene and care. It’s a great spot for people of all ages to relax, chat, and enjoy delicious treats.

For outdoor fun, Box Street also has a well-maintained turf that can be hired on an hourly basis at ₹800 per hour. This is ideal for groups who wish to play games, arrange small gatherings, or simply enjoy sports in a friendly environment.

Toilets at Box Street are open daily from 3:00 PM until midnight. They remain closed before that time to avoid misuse by outsiders. This ensures that the facilities are reserved only for genuine guests and families who come to enjoy the place.

When it comes to travel, it is more convenient if you have your own vehicle. However, auto-rickshaws are also available between Box Street and Vasai station, and the fare is usually around ₹100 per person. This makes it fairly easy to reach the location even without your own transport.

Overall, Box Street, Vasai, is a safe, hygienic, and family-friendly destination where you can enjoy food, fun, and relaxation all in one place.

featured_reviews.name: Vidyadheesh Upadhye
featured_reviews.review_text:
Maharashtra, much like any other state in India, does have a rich culinary heritage. The symbols of its vegetarian cuisine have been Misal & Batata Wada (in the form of Wada Pav). There are a plethora of dishes but these are the most popular ones where vegetarian Maharashtrian cuisine is unknown.

My search for a decent plate of Misal has taken me places far & wide. This time it brought me to Santosh Misal Pav, located in the by-lanes of Vasai, a suburb of Mumbai.

This place is run by a family consisting of father, mother & son. They are very courteous & totally customer oriented. They constantly keep checking with each customer about their requirements to ensure that they have had their fill.

The menu is very simple & basic; Misal, Dahi Misal, Poha, Batata Wada, Idli & Buttermilk. While Poha, Idli & Batata Wada are available only for breakfast, Misal is available till closing hours i.e. 2.30 pm.

The Misal is made of moth beans (matki), farsan which includes chiwda, ghatia, peanuts, chopped onions & a spicy gravy. It is finally topped with fine & thin sev and served with 2 pieces of Pav. The gravy can be made more spicy, if required, by helping of a seperate spicy gravy.

The Misal was superb & tasted wonderful. It gave me a runny nose all throughout but I enjoyed eating it nonetheless in fact asked for an extra helping of the gravy. The Misal didn't give me any after effects of a spicy gravy like burning sensation or burps or the need have lots of water.

I had the buttermilk also which was really nice as well. They had added a crushed jeera masala which gave a nice flavour to it.

I am coming again whenever I'm in the vicinity. Are you?

featured_reviews.name: Ranajit Das
featured_reviews.review_text:
Surti Namkeens in Vasant Nagari, opposite Art Hospital, is a haven for snack lovers, especially if you crave the authentic flavors of Gujarat. The shop offers a wide variety of snacks, including khakhras, farsans, chips, cookies, and sweets. I simply loved their selection of khakhras made from millets like bajra and nachni. The Achari khakhra was a standout. The cookies are also a must try.

We had the pleasure of meeting the owner, Upasana, who suggested we try their DIY pani puri masalas. Overall, it's a place I'd highly recommend.

featured_reviews.name: Priya Sav
featured_reviews.review_text: Their Gujarati snacks are simply unbeatable. Whether you're in the mood for crispy samosas, flavorful kachoris, this store has it all. Each snack is bursting with authentic flavors that will leave you wanting more. Surti Namkeen is the best sweets and snacks shop in Vasai that truly takes snacking to a whole new level!
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you Priya for your kind words, we always pay attention to the happiness and taste of our customers.

featured_reviews.review_text: If you're in Vasai and looking for a store with a huge variety of Gujarati snacks, chocolates, and drinks, look no further than Surti Namkeen. This place is a treasure trove of unique flavors and options. They have snacks that cater to every taste bud, chocolates that are pure bliss, and a range of refreshing drinks that quench your thirst like no other. It's truly the best store in town!

name: The unknown chef & Tasty taste
description: The Unknown Chef (TUC) – Tasty Taste Express is your go-to destination for fresh sandwiches and authentic street food flavors. We serve a wide variety of Veg Sandwiches, Cheese Toasts, Bombay Sandwiches, and special Cheese Burst creations along with popular chat items like Pani Puri, Shev Puri, Dahi Puri, Ragda Puri, Bhel, and Cheese Bhel. Every dish is freshly prepared using quality ingredients with hygiene and taste as our priority. Affordable pricing, quick service, and delicious street-style flavors make us a favorite spot for snacks, evening cravings, and quick bites. Experience tasty food made with passion by The Unknown Chef.😎

featured_reviews.name: Urmila Pandey
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a great experience ordering Sev Puri from Behind the Mask. The delivery was quick and the food arrived fresh and well packed. The Sev Puri was perfectly prepared – crispy puris, flavorful chutneys, and the right balance of sweet, spicy, and tangy taste.

The quality and hygiene were impressive, and the packaging ensured everything stayed intact during delivery. It truly felt like street-style chaat with a clean and professional touch.

Highly recommended for anyone craving delicious chaat with reliable delivery. Looking forward to ordering again!
